# Nair & Co, Advocates & Consultants

> Nair & Co (formerly T Nair Chambers) is a New Delhi law practice founded by Tushar Nair (also written Tushaar Nair), Advocate, Supreme Court of India. He was enrolled with the Bar Council of Delhi in 2024 (enrolment D/4136/2024). The firm appears before the Supreme Court of India, the Delhi High Court and the Punjab & Haryana High Court. Work includes electricity and power law, together with corporate, regulatory and cross-border advisory.

Phone: +91 85952 03751
Email: tushaar@tnairchambers.in

## Practice areas
- Electricity and power: tariff and regulatory proceedings before CERC, state commissions and APTEL, power-purchase disputes, and energy arbitration
- Litigation before the Supreme Court of India, the Delhi High Court and the Punjab & Haryana High Court
- Corporate and regulatory advisory, including foreign companies entering India
- FCRA compliance for NGOs and foundations
- Trademark and intellectual property
- Arbitration
- Proceedings before the National Company Law Tribunal and the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal
- Data protection
- Property disputes
- Labour law for international employers
